tools.name: smarty_verify_us_address
tools.description: Check one US address against USPS reference data and return the standardized form, delivery and ZIP+4, and the match and DPV codes. Each call uses one Smarty lookup. Use smarty_reverse_geocode_us for coordinates and smarty_us_address_property for property data.

tools.name: smarty_lookup_us_zipcode
tools.description: Find the valid city, state and ZIP Code combinations for a city and state, or confirm a ZIP Code. Send city with state, or zipcode alone. Each call uses one Smarty lookup.

tools.name: smarty_reverse_geocode_us
tools.description: Find the US street addresses near a latitude and longitude. Returns an empty result when no address is near the point. Each call uses one Smarty lookup.

tools.name: smarty_verify_international_address
tools.description: Check one address outside the US against Smarty's international reference data and return the standardized form and the match status. Each call uses one Smarty lookup. US addresses belong in smarty_verify_us_address.

tools.name: smarty_us_address_property
tools.description: Return property and financial data for one US address from Smarty's enrichment data (owner and assessment fields, when the plan includes them). Each call uses one Smarty lookup.

tools.name: smarty_us_address_geo_reference
tools.description: Return the census geographic reference of one US address: tract, block, and FIPS codes. Each call uses one Smarty lookup.

tools.name: smarty_us_address_secondary_units
tools.description: List the secondary units (apartments, suites, floors) of one US building address, for example to identify multi-unit buildings. Each call uses one Smarty lookup.
